question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, and Claire is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) fullback

segments.text: Okay, so I need to figure out what position Alice ends up playing at the end of the soccer match.
Let me break it down step by step.
First swap: Claire and Alice trade.
So, Alice moves to Fullback, and Claire moves to Cheerleader.
Next swap: Bob and Claire trade.
So, Bob moves to Cheerleader, and Claire moves to Right winger.
Third swap: Claire and Alice trade again.
So, Alice moves back to Cheerleader, and Claire moves back to Fullback.
Wait, that can't be right because Bob was already swapped.
After the first swap, Alice is Fullback, Claire is Cheerleader.
Then Bob and Claire swap: Bob goes to Cheerleader, Claire goes to Right winger.
Then Claire and Alice swap again: Alice goes back to Cheerleader, Claire goes to Fullback.
So yes, Alice ends up as Cheerleader again.
